capture_method: Two read-only launchctl domain listings followed by four concurrent workers querying all listed com.apple. jobs; full outputs hashed, structural root fields and complete endpoint blocks retained. Domain and job queries are not atomic.

capture_probes.name: host_special_launchd_probe.py
capture_probes.code:
import subprocess,json,hashlib,datetime,re
out=[]
for label in ['system','gui/501']:
 t0=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();r=subprocess.run(['/bin/launchctl','print',label],capture_output=True,text=True)
 s={'domain':label,'started_UTC':t0,'ended_UTC':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout_size':len(r.stdout.encode()),'stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),'stderr':r.stderr,'special_lines':[line for line in r.stdout.splitlines()if re.search(r'host.special|special.port',line,re.I)]}
 # Only structural identifiers and the services table are retained, never environment.
 lines=r.stdout.splitlines();s['sections']=[line for line in lines if re.fullmatch(r'\t[^\t]+ = \{',line)]
 rows=[];inside=False
 for line in lines:
  if line=='\tservices = {':inside=True;continue
  if inside:
   if line=='\t}':break
   rows.append(line)
 s['services_lines']=rows;out.append(s)
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in s.items()if k!='services_lines'}),flush=True)
 print(json.dumps({'services_rows':len(rows),'first_rows':rows[:6]}),flush=True)
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/host_special_launchd_probe.json','w'),indent=2)
